First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @madisonqueerbikeride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Madison Queer Bike Ride group ride

A casual monthly ride for queer folks and friends, meant to be less competitive and less heteronormative than the usual group ride. Any bike that can handle pavement and path. There is a social stop each ride, indoors in winter. Runs all year except extreme cold or cold rain. Start time and route go up on Instagram.
